mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity ( identity_verification_id, user_id, purpose, status, requested_at ) VALUES ( #{identityVerificationId}, #{userId}, #{purpose}, #{status}, #{requestedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT identity_id, identity_verification_id, user_id, purpose, status, requested_at, verified_at, expires_at, used_at, failure_reason FROM identity WHERE identity_verification_id = #{identityVerificationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE identity SET status = 'VERIFIED', verified_at = #{verifiedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, failure_reason = NULL WHERE identity_verification_id = #{identityVerificationId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
